career_ladder.note: The Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL) is a leading public sector general insurance company wholly owned by the Government of India. Administrative Officers (Scale I) are recruited in Generalist and Specialist cadres (Accounts, Legal, Engineering, Medical, IT, Actuarial). Career progression is regulated by the General Insurance (Rationalisation of Pay Scales and Other Conditions of Service of Officers) Scheme.

steps.designation: General Manager (GM - Scale VII) / Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD)

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Administrative Officer (Scale I) in OICL comprises a three-tier process: Phase I Preliminary Examination (Objective, 100 marks), Phase II Main Examination (Objective 200 marks + Descriptive English 30 marks = 230 marks total), followed by Phase III Interview. In objective papers of both Phase I and Phase II, a penalty of 1/4th (0.25) mark is deducted for each incorrect response.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Sectional and aggregate qualifying marks apply

papers.paper_name: Descriptive Test: English Language (Letter Writing - 10 marks & Essay - 20 marks)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying score required (evaluated only if objective cutoff is cleared)

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview (Designated OICL centers across India)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final selection based on combined scores of Phase II (Mains) and Interview

financial_package.note: Scale I Administrative Officers in OICL receive basic pay starting at ₹50,925 in the scale of ₹50,925 - 2,500(14) - 85,925 - 2,710(4) - 96,765 under the General Insurance rationalised pay scale. Total initial monthly gross emoluments are approximately ₹85,000 to ₹88,000 in metro cities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: OICL — Recruitment of Administrative Officers (Scale I) Notification (Emoluments & Benefits)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on entry basic pay of ₹50,925 plus applicable Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance (10% to 7% based on posting tier), and City Compensatory Allowance; net in-hand factors in defined pension contribution and standard tax deductions.
official_perks: Company-provided accommodation or House Rent Allowance as per rules
Comprehensive medical coverage and Group Hospitalisation Insurance for officer and dependents
Defined contribution pension scheme and Gratuity benefits
Leave Travel Subsidy / Concession and leave encashment
Concessional staff loans for housing, vehicles, and consumer durables

competition_benchmarks.note: OICL conducts recruitment for Administrative Officers (Scale I) for Generalist and Specialist cadres. In the 2024 recruitment cycle, a total of 100 vacancies were notified across Disciplines (Accounts, Actuarial, Engineering, Legal, and Medical).
